_comment: Exclusions applied when scoring lcov streams. excludePatterns are regexes, so a literal dot must be escaped: an unescaped one matches any character and silently drops production files. This file decides what the coverage gate counts; bunfig.toml and vitest.config.ts decide what each runner instruments in the first place.

excludeFiles.name: kiro.ts
excludeFiles.reason: App entry point with side effects

_comment_stream_scoping: tui-only exclusions live in the bun and tuiVitest lcovFilters so the twinkiVitest stream measures packages/twinki for the code-quality gate; global excludeDirectories hold only universally-excluded names. hooks/ is filtered from bun, whose V8 provider misattributes hook coverage, and measured by tuiVitest, which instruments src/hooks/** for that reason.
